concepts.name: 余烬·错压
concepts.design: Crimson/coral asymmetrical fault-press warhammer. Unusual T head made of THREE massive diagonally sheared parallelepiped slabs, closely stacked in a sloping offset staircase from left-high to right-low, with narrow luminous seams. A huge vertical rectangular blunt impact plate on the LEFT locks all three slabs together, the RIGHT end terminates as a shorter thick beveled butt. Broad dark red planes and coral bevels. No hollow ring or triangular yoke: thick offset dogleg solid neck firmly joins stack center to shaft. Head width about 40 percent of weapon length. Shaft has elongated octagonal profile and recessed red line, plain two grip zones. Squared heavy butt pommel. A few bright small red rectangular chips drift near impact plate, readable low glow. Graphic brutal force, asymmetrical industrial geometry without screws or machinery.

concepts.name: 流萤·绞岚
concepts.design: Emerald/mint horizontal spiral-drum warhammer. Large short chunky BARREL head with blunt thick HEXAGONAL end caps facing LEFT and RIGHT, connected by THREE thick flat helicoidal bands winding around horizontal barrel axis. Bands make only about half a turn, with wide OPEN diagonal windows between them; reveal a small stout structural axle inside, no crossed eye-shaped loops. End caps are angular and larger than spiral cage, suitable for heavy impacts. Horizontal head axis perpendicular to long shaft. Deep jade opaque broad helical ribbons with softly glowing mint edges, a few tiny mint crescent particles in open channels. Head attached from below via short solid hexagonal hub. Long thick simple straight handle, two comfortable grip zones, hexagonal end weight. A substantial architectural twisted drum rather than a delicate vine.

concepts.name: 寒汐·贯潮
concepts.design: Petrol blue/cyan horizontal battering-ram warhammer. A long stout octagonal PRISM hammer head extends horizontally left-to-right, with massive thick OCTAGONAL blunt striking disk at each end. Center is narrow waist held inside a robust angular U-shaped cradle rising from shaft. The left impact disk is much wider than right. Along the central prism, THREE narrow recessed cyan channels run parallel to the horizontal axis; two chunky square collars interrupt them, giving a segmented ram silhouette, no vertical twin towers. Long straight blue shaft with broad trapezoidal shoulders and two unornamented gripping zones. Flat stepped octagonal pommel. Tiny cyan dash particles escaping parallel to the head near end faces, no giant energy beam. Deep blue opaque energy planes and aqua glow edges, monumental kinetic design.

concepts.name: 梦隙·叠轨
concepts.design: Violet/lavender layered orbital warhammer. Broad squat horizontal head built from THREE thick rounded-square annular frames, aligned on the LEFT-RIGHT strike axis but each rotated roughly 25 degrees relative to next, producing a stacked twisting architectural tunnel. Frames have broad flat walls and softly beveled corners, large openings visible in three-quarter view, dark purple inner faces. Four stout recessed connecting bars join frames at corners; no truly floating pieces. LEFT and RIGHT outer frames carry thick solid blunt square striking caps; central front opening reveals a small faceted purple energy core attached with two discreet short struts. Clearly a solid heavy hammer head, not a giant ring atop a staff. Long robust violet handle descends from saddle beneath middle frame, two smooth straight grip zones, compact diamond-section pommel. Sparse lavender diamond particles between frames, moderate luminous lavender edges with violet body, no six-pointed star or large halo.
